name: WorldLook
author: Dominik
description: Native sky with mild clock-weighted light and clear coastal water. Correct HHMM time conversion and one session toggle. Water shader embedded in the DLL.
manualTrigger: Ctrl+Shift+F7 toggles light and water together for the session. Configuration is read on startup from UserData/WorldLook/WorldLook.json. F9 diagnostics removed in dev.3.
reportPath: Startup, toggle confirmations and warnings/errors in MelonLoader/Latest.log; on-demand MCP status via WorldLook.Automation. Existing status.json reports are historical only; scoped evidence is in docs/in-game-acceptance.md
limitations: Native sky/clouds/sun/moon/stars remain game-owned. Mild warmth peaks at 06:00 and 18:00, neutral at noon/night. Water targets only Main/Map/StylizedWater2_Ocean and needs camera depth/opaque input requests; those settings do not prove texture contents. Dev.2 water/ON-OFF owner-accepted 2026-10-24; dev.3 normal night owner-accepted 2026-10-25. Dev.5 reference-shader reload repair passed four same-process singleplayer MCP roundtrips on 2026-10-25. Overall completion owner-confirmed 2026-10-25, referring to the prior session without an exact acceptance time or itemized actions. No remaining acceptance backlog. A separate visible-warmth test was not itemized and quantitative frame times were not measured; multiplayer is out of scope.
removal: With the game closed, remove Mods/WorldLook.dll and its optional PDB/metadata under UserData/WorldLook. Keep Shared. The old external s1reference.bundle belongs to the archived 0.1.x build.
